facts_of_case: Marriage of Sushil Kumar and Minto Kumari was solemnized on 8/5/1993. Respondent gave birth to a male child on 14/10/1993 within five months & six days of the marriage. Appellant sought divorce under Section 12(1)(d) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: DNA test can be relied upon to prove biological relationship
legal_principles.held: In view of the scientific report of DNA test, now it has been categorically proved that male child Sheel Kumar is not the biological son of appellant-Sushil Kumar.
cited_cases: Sushil Kumar vs Minto Kumari on 15 September, 2011

legal_principles.principle: Overwhelming evidence cannot be ignored in annulment of marriage
legal_principles.held: Evidence of the DNA, which has been submitted before this court cannot be relied to annul the marriage by ignoring the overwhelming evidence, which has been produced by her before the learned Additional District Judge No.1, Bharatpur.
cited_cases: Sushil Kumar vs Minto Kumari on 15 September, 2011

outcome.final_order: Petition seeking divorce was rejected by the trial court and the appeal is also dismissed.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for nullity of marriage
advising on grounds for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act
